name: engagement
description: Engagement v1.0.0 - Trigger /engagement:comment-responder with an optional duration (4 days, 24 hours, 1 week) and/or a video id. Fetches unanswered YouTube comments through the Data API, drafts a reply to each in the voice supplied by the engagement-profile skill, and presents a stacked .docx review for edit and approval. Per-row approval; zero auto-post.
